the_settled_stage_anatomy: One Learning Block (term DECIDED 2026-08-01): input DOOR (code-floor contract; insufficient shape refuses with the lack named) -> the WORK -> the TRACE (every firing, green included, consumer-typed at write: debug expires unused at 30 days, training pairs persist, tree-embedding is primary data; no consumer named = no trace written) -> the INSPECTOR (per-stage, emits a BULLET-LIST finding, each bullet stratum-tagged code/tree/Hex; it learns one function: what will Akien gate) -> the GATE (Akien, enforcer and trainer: questions, approve or disprove; every verdict is a labeled training pair; approvals are the denominator; his repeated gate-questions accrete into the probe corpus as lane-one members) -> the DIAL (per-block counters: firings, send-backs, approvals, disproves, prediction-match rate; delegation when the inspector matches him over a window he sets; demotion door — a delegated gate that starts surprising him returns to his desk). Three loops per stage: inspector learns his gate; block logic migrates down the strata; gate-questions become probes. MIGRATION IS ONE-BLOW across the small skill set, then workflows — the gradient-vs-mandate challenge finding was resolved by Akien: N is small, convert whole. He is the gating condition at the start by design; first delegation targets = whichever gates eat his minutes fastest.

Findings and their fates: gradient-not-mandate -> OVERRULED by Akien (small N, one blow); one shared gate primitive -> stands as suggestion; term binding -> DECIDED, Learning Block; gate-can't-see-substance -> resolved: it can, if it starts with and is trained from him; trace-drain -> resolved: consumer-typed traces, debug expires at 30 days unused; 'nothing to skate with' -> stays a hypothesis until refusal/escape rates are measured (Law 3); migration-needs-demotion-door -> folded into the dial; 'prove' -> 'adjudicate the state of knowledge with provenance' stands.
the_intention_in_one_line: Learning blocks all the way down: every skill, every workflow stage, and the system as a whole is a question nexus with a hard gate that can send back on insufficient input, a trace of every firing (green AND red), and logic that migrates from LLM ceiling to graph tree to code as yield accrues — the same rigor the components got, applied to the process that builds them.
the_funnel: idea -> intention -> ticket -> code for most things; idea -> ruling as the short path through the intake gate. The 'idea' type is the funnel's mouth: frictionless intake (the /note stance) but with a forced eventual disposition — an idea becomes an intention, a ruling, or is retired; never a graveyard (the no-drain lesson, 2026-07-22).
cc_read_field_parallels: Factored cognition (Ought; Elicit runs it on scientific literature) is the prior art for claim-decomposition-with-evidence — cite, don't graft. What is NOT in the field's version and is Cairn's: yield-measured probes, gates that refuse, and model-to-structure distillation (the field distills model-to-model; Cairn distills model-to-tree/code — the distinctive bet). DSPy-shaped compilation is the nearest engineering artifact to 'logic gets pushed to code as we go'. In-house first: the claim-tree substrate is the librarian thread (cross-tree question, tenure loop) generalized to the top level.
cc_read_neurology: Predictive processing: a hierarchy where predictions flow down and only ERRORS flow up — a send-back IS a prediction error, so gates fire on surprise/mismatch, never on schedule (event-not-poll, with a brain behind it). Consolidation (hippocampus->cortex replay) is the overnight drain and the voyage->history freeze: sleep is not optional bookkeeping in any learning system. AMENDED BY THE LEAH LESSON: surprise ROUTES the errors, but greens are the DENOMINATOR — yield is hits-over-firings and is uncomputable without recording the unsurprising firings (turnscan's precedent: 466 turns counted so 6 reds could mean 1.3%). And n=1 is an anecdote; the second instance is where knowing starts. So every block records every firing, green included; surprise decides what travels up, the full count decides what the rates mean.
cc_read_process_automation: The andon cord (Toyota): any station stops the line, causes are fixed at source, and the line stops LESS over time — send-back at all steps, solved a century ago. Its known failure mode to pre-empt: alarm fatigue and gaming. A block that never refuses is vacuous; one that refuses constantly is mis-gated — so REFUSAL RATES are themselves yield-measured from day one (the turnscan discipline applied to every brick's gate), or the skating just moves one level up: past gates instead of past questions.
cc_read_sequencing: (1) Instrument superclaude with logger_for_bash — full forensic trace every run, green or not; not urgent, but the trace is what every later brick learns FROM, and it blueprints the pattern (trace -> eval -> gate -> distill, the field's convergent recipe). (2) The flash does not reopen the plan, it RE-EXPLAINS it: the standing order was already 'skill chain at link 2, /intent first' — /intent is the natural template brick (five probes, a refusal edge, schema-gated output waiting in the /chart design). Turning IT into the first true learning block merges the standing course with this vision; no new arc. (3) The frontier projector + what-next review feed the top-level nexus its inputs. (4) Only then generalize outward.
cc_read_the_top_levels_own_yield: If the system-as-a-whole is a learning block, its measurement is the MIGRATION RATE: how much adjudication moved from LLM ceiling to tree or code per week. That one number IS 'the system is becoming learning blocks' — the cocoon withdrawal dial, now with a metric.
